description: This file declares the AttachSamples class, which is a task for attaching media samples (audio and video) in a media player context. It includes data structures for audio and video data, and references external media pipeline and player interfaces.

classes.name: AttachSamples
classes.description: A class representing a task to attach media samples (audio and video) to the media pipeline, used within the Rialto media server.

methods.name: AttachSamples
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the task with the media context, player, and media segments.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the task to attach media samples to the media pipeline.
